title: The corrected density preserves the value and first normal jet
statement: For homogeneous quartic F0 on full2x2 matrices,H=F0|Sym,assume actual Hessian gap>=c[|S|^2<|X|^2>+<|X|^4>] at EVERY mean/actual Hessian,c>0. Set delta=c/16,H1=H-delta|S|^4,c0=c,c1=c/2,R=F0-H(sym B),z=B12-B21,C=36||H1||coeff1,CR=48||R||rawcoeff1. D=C+2C^2/c0,B2=2C^2/c1+3C/2,B4=108C^4/c1^3+9C^2/(4c1)+3C/2,Bz=32^4B4. ANY finite a>=max(1,D/(2delta),8B2/delta,8Bz/delta,CR^2/(4delta^2)) makes F_a=F0+delta[(|sym B|^2+a z^2)^2-|sym B|^4] globally QC AND ROC at every affine mean/actual W1,4 gradient. Dilated normal metric makes R+(delta/2)N_a convex;actual Hodge errors are absorbed by its remaining norm-quartic curvature,not a nonnegative penalty reserve. Applied to ORIGINAL Jr(T_rB)/(kappa sigma^2),c_r=1/[201326592(1+r^4)],this yields Jhat=Jr+K2 U^2|sym(T_r^-1 A)|^2+K4U^4,K2=2kappa delta a,K4=kappa delta a^2/sigma^2. Value and FIRST normal derivative agree on U0;higher normal curvature is changed. Literal a=2^186,2^186,2^198 at r3/4,1,2 are sufficient,not sharp/efficient. Mechanism explicitly attributed to Dal Maso-Fonseca-Leoni-Morini2003 Theorem1.1/formula3.8;quantitative coupling-formulation novelty unresolved.
